title: The UAE network: Tahnoon, G42, MGX and their US deals
summary: Almost every link in the claim is documented. Tahnoon-linked vehicles bought 49% of World Liberty (Aryam, Jan 2025) and reportedly 49% of the holding company behind its OCC trust bank (StringZ, per the WSJ in Aug 2026). MGX settled its $2B Binance deal in USD1, funds Stargate, holds 15% of the Trump-approved TikTok US joint venture, and has invested in OpenAI, xAI and Anthropic. G42 has Microsoft's $1.5B, US chip licences and the Stargate UAE campus, and a G42 crypto executive advised WLF. Three points are weaker. ADQ is not documented as an Affinity investor; Lunate is, and it is majority-owned by a Tahnoon-overseen vehicle. StringZ's ownership rests on anonymous WSJ sourcing that the OCC filing does not confirm. Several 2026 G42 developments come from single sources. No quid pro quo has been documented, and WLF, the White House and Trump deny any link to policy.

sub_claims.statement: Aryam Investment 1, backed by Tahnoon, bought 49% of World Liberty Financial, and G42's Peng Xiao and lawyer Martin Edelman took WLF board seats.
sub_claims.finding: Per the WSJ (2026-02-01), as relayed by several outlets, Aryam agreed on about 2025-01-16 to pay $500M for 49%. $250M was paid upfront, about $187M of it to Trump-family entities. Two Aryam executives who also hold top G42 posts, Peng Xiao (G42 CEO) and Martin Edelman (a US lawyer listed as a G42 official; one dossier calls him G42's general counsel), joined WLF's five-member board. No US approval was sought or disclosed. Sens. Warren and Kim asked Treasury Secretary Bessent in Feb 2026 to have CFIUS review the stake, and a House inquiry opened on 2026-02-05. No public CFIUS outcome was found. An unnamed person familiar with the deal said it involved no G42 money. WLF spokesman David Wachsman confirmed the investment to the WSJ; Trump said he had no knowledge of it.

sub_claims.statement: MGX, chaired by Tahnoon, settled its $2B Binance investment in WLF's USD1.
sub_claims.finding: Established in C07. MGX announced the $2B minority stake on 2025-03-12, and WLF said on 2025-05-01 that USD1 would settle it. Tahnoon chairs MGX, which G42 and Mubadala founded in 2024. No US approval applied, since this was a foreign investor buying into a non-US exchange. MGX says it chose USD1 itself and that it has not invested in WLF.

SoftBank, OpenAI, Oracle and MGX were named initial equity funders of the $500B Stargate project at the White House on 2025-01-21 (see C08). MGX also co-founded the AI Infrastructure Partnership with BlackRock, GIP, Microsoft and Nvidia. That partnership, with MGX and GIP, agreed in Oct 2025 to buy Aligned Data Centers for about $40B, and the deal closed around July 2026. Coverage said a CFIUS review was expected, but no outcome was found.

sub_claims.statement: MGX took a stake in the TikTok US joint venture that Trump approved.
sub_claims.finding: On 2025-09-25 Trump signed an executive order declaring the framework a qualified divestiture under the 2024 divest-or-ban law. Vice President Vance put the US entity's value at about $14B. Agreements were signed around 2025-12-18/19. Oracle, Silver Lake and MGX each hold 15% of TikTok USDS Joint Venture LLC. Affiliates of existing ByteDance investors hold 30.1%, and ByteDance keeps 19.9%. The deal closed on 2026-01-22 (Axios, Hollywood Reporter), the day before the enforcement deadline. The joint venture's board named Adam Presser CEO; its seven-member board includes MGX's chief strategy and safety officer David Scott alongside Silver Lake's Egon Durban and Oracle's Kenneth Glueck. The recommendation algorithm is to be retrained on US data and held in Oracle's cloud. The approval was the president's own determination under the statute. MGX's individual price was not disclosed.

sub_claims.statement: MGX has invested in OpenAI, xAI and Anthropic.
sub_claims.finding: xAI: MGX was named in the upsized $20B Series E announced about 2026-01-06, alongside QIA, Nvidia and others. Anthropic: MGX was among the co-leads of the $30B Series G at a $380B post-money valuation (Feb 2026, led by GIC and Coatue), and it is named in the $65B Series H at $965B (2026-05-28). OpenAI: MGX was a lead investor, described by most outlets as a co-lead with SoftBank and others, in the $122B round at $852B closed 2026-03-31. Per-investor amounts were not disclosed. MGX closed a fund of about $49-50B in mid-2026. No US government approval of these minority stakes was reported.

sub_claims.statement: G42 has a Microsoft partnership, US chip licences and the Stargate UAE campus.
sub_claims.finding: Microsoft invested $1.5B for a minority stake on 2024-04-16. The deal is governed by an Intergovernmental Assurance Agreement with US and UAE government input, Brad Smith joined G42's board, and G42 reportedly agreed to drop Huawei gear and exit China. Stargate UAE, a 1GW G42-built cluster with OpenAI, Oracle, Nvidia, Cisco and SoftBank inside a 5GW US-UAE campus, was announced in May 2025. Its first 200MW was due in 2026, and no confirmation that it is online was found. Commerce authorized Microsoft's chip transfers to the UAE in Sept 2025, then up to 35,000 GB300-equivalent chips for G42 (and as many for Saudi Arabia's Humain) on about 2025-11-20, with security conditions. Later 2026 items: the 2026-07-10 BIS move of the UAE into Country Group A:5 (naming G42 and Core42 for licence-free chip receipt) is documented in C80, including a Senate Banking minority statement. The reported G42 reincorporation as a US company remains unconfirmed: beyond a WSJ-relayed report (July 2026), Bloomberg (about 2026-09-04) reported only exploratory talks to sell a US-majority stake or create a US vehicle, driven by the licence-free window that runs to about April 2027; G42 has not confirmed a transaction and no completed restructuring was found through mid-Nov 2026. A Bloomberg-cited report that initial permits excluded G42 conflicts with the November approval.

sub_claims.statement: A G42 crypto executive reportedly advised WLF.
sub_claims.finding: The NYT (Sept 2025) reported that Fiacc Larkin, G42's head of crypto, served as WLF's 'chief strategic adviser' from January 2025 while still at G42. Fortune relays the report and cites his LinkedIn, and the Senate Banking minority staff report repeats it. The NYT original was not accessed, and neither WLF nor G42 has commented publicly on his role in sources found.

sub_claims.statement: StringZ Holding, linked to Tahnoon, is in WLF's trust bank.
sub_claims.finding: OCC Corporate Decision #1385 (preliminary conditional approval, 2026-08-14) lists StringZ Holding RSC (DE) LLC among investors giving passivity commitments, but it does not name StringZ's owner or the size of its stake. The WSJ reported on 2026-08-27, citing people familiar, that Tahnoon's group is behind StringZ and that it owns 49% of WLTC Holdings, the bank's parent, with a Trump-family entity holding about 38%. StringZ was registered in Abu Dhabi in April 2025 and in Delaware a month later. One report says a WLF spokesperson confirmed the arrangement without giving details. The required approval is the OCC charter, which is still preliminary, with passivity agreements from the large holders.

sub_claims.statement: ADQ/Lunate invested in Kushner's Affinity Partners.
sub_claims.finding: Lunate and QIA added $1.5B to Affinity in Dec 2024, bringing AUM to $4.6B, and Kushner names Lunate among Affinity's three largest LPs with PIF and QIA. No source shows ADQ itself as an investor. The tie to Tahnoon runs through ownership: Lunate is majority-owned by Chimera Investment, which Tahnoon oversees, and it was seeded with ADQ assets while Tahnoon chaired ADQ. ADQ was folded into L'IMAD, chaired by Crown Prince Khaled bin Mohamed, in Jan 2026. As a private fund raise, this needed no US approval.

corrections: The claim says 'ADQ/Lunate' invested in Affinity; reporting names Lunate (with QIA), not ADQ. ADQ's link is historical, through Tahnoon's chairmanship and seeding of Lunate.
StringZ's Tahnoon ownership and 49% stake come from anonymous WSJ sourcing (2026-08-27); the OCC decision names StringZ but not its owner or stake size.
The TikTok joint venture stake is 15% for MGX; early reports describing a 45% combined Oracle/Silver Lake/MGX share were superseded by the Dec 2025 terms.
MGX's exact role in the OpenAI round (co-lead vs lead participant) is described inconsistently; per-investor amounts in the OpenAI, xAI and Anthropic rounds are undisclosed.
denials_and_context: Trump said he did not know about the Aryam deal ('my sons are handling that'); the White House says his assets are in a trust run by his children.
A WLF spokesperson said any claim the Aryam deal had anything to do with the administration's chip actions is '100% false'; spokesman David Wachsman said Trump and Witkoff had no involvement.
A person familiar with the Aryam investment told the WSJ it did not involve G42 money and was never discussed with Trump (anonymous).
MGX says it chose USD1 itself and has not invested in WLF (per C07 sourcing).
The OCC said career staff reviewed the WLTC charter and rejected conflict-of-interest comments; passivity commitments bar StringZ and the Trump entity from controlling the bank.

Much of the MGX AI portfolio (Stargate, OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, Aligned) is ordinary large-scale sovereign investing alongside US firms; there is no evidence it required or received favours. The policy-relevant approvals are the chip licences (Commerce/BIS), the TikTok determination (the president) and the bank charter (OCC).

Disclosure: this write-up was produced with an Anthropic model; Anthropic is one of the MGX portfolio companies listed here. Facts about that investment are taken from Anthropic's own announcements and press coverage.

leads.title: MGX and the $40B Aligned Data Centers takeover
leads.why_connected: Tahnoon-chaired MGX co-bought a major US data-centre operator via the AI Infrastructure Partnership with BlackRock, Microsoft and Nvidia; a CFIUS review was expected but its outcome is unreported.

leads.title: G42's reported reincorporation as a US company and the UAE's 2026 export-control upgrade
leads.why_connected: A WSJ-relayed report says G42 will reincorporate as a mostly US-owned company as the UAE won broader chip access; unverified, but it would change the licensing picture for Tahnoon's flagship AI firm.

leads.title: Outcome of the Warren/Kim CFIUS request and House inquiry into the Aryam stake
leads.why_connected: Senators asked Treasury in Feb 2026 whether CFIUS reviewed the 49% WLF stake; no public answer was found, and the same question now applies to StringZ's 49% of the trust bank parent.

leads.title: Lunate's takeover of G42's China fund
leads.why_connected: Lunate, the Tahnoon-linked Affinity LP, took over G42's China-focused fund in 2024 as G42 unwound China ties under US pressure; it links the Kushner money trail to the G42 security questions.
